lines.en: label dormwartwo14:
{i}Roughly fifteen minutes later...at a bar with a horrible name...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大约十五分钟后……在一家名字糟透了的酒吧里……{/i}

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar1
$ dorm2war2points += 1
: Ladies and...oh. I guess Sensei isn’t here yet. So...just ladies, then!
lines.zh: : 女士们，还有……哦。看来老师还没到。那么……就只有女士们了！

lines.en: : Please feast your eyes on the amazing...outstanding...and only {i}mildly{/i} incorrigible...Kirin Kanda!
lines.zh: : 请各位睁大眼睛看好了——了不起的……出类拔萃的……而且只是{i}略微{/i}无可救药的……Kirin Kanda！

lines.en: : That’s right, that’s right. It is I, Kirin Kanda, who has located the trophy and brought home one more point to the lovely ladies of the second floor.
lines.zh: : 没错，没错。正是在下 Kirin Kanda 找到了奖杯，为二楼可爱的女士们再添一分。

lines.en: : Please hold your applause as I already know how great I am. But, if any of you find yourself absolutely {i}needing{/i} to congratulate me in some way, please note that I will always accept massages. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 请各位收起掌声，我已经知道自己有多厉害了。不过，如果你们当中有人实在{i}非要{/i}以某种方式祝贺我，请注意，按摩我是一概接受的。谢谢。

lines.en: : And please don’t feast your eyes on me...Ami Arakawa. The loser.
lines.zh: : 还有，请各位千万别把目光放在我身上……Ami Arakawa。输家。

lines.en: : They...{i}did{/i} have an unfair advantage with Noriko on their team considering that she’s from the area and whatnot...
lines.zh: : 她们……{i}确实{/i}占了不公平的优势，毕竟 Noriko 在她们队里，而她又是本地人什么的……

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar2
: But it was not {i}me{/i} who found the treasure, it was Kirin! All by herself without any assistance at all!
lines.zh: : 可找到宝藏的人不是{i}我{/i}，是 Kirin！全靠她自己，一点外援都没有！

lines.en: : That’s right. I didn’t find this because of Noriko. I found it because of my deep connection to Miku and my ability to sniff out her scent from miles away.
lines.zh: : 没错。我找到它不是因为 Noriko，而是因为我和 Miku 之间深厚的羁绊，以及我从几英里外嗅出她气味的能力。

lines.en: : Exactly. But, to be fair, Miku’s so far into gyarudom right now that anyone could smell her perfume from miles away.
lines.zh: : 正是。不过说句公道话，Miku 现在辣妹化得那么彻底，谁都能在几英里外闻到她的香水味。

lines.en: : Please leave Miku alone as it’s her first time doing such things and that there will likely be several mistakes.
lines.zh: : 请别为难 Miku，她可是头一回做这种事，估计会出不少差错。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar3
: How’d things go on your end, Ayane? I mean...you obviously didn’t find the trophy, but...did you guys have fun, at least?
lines.zh: : 你们那边怎么样，Ayane？我是说……你们显然没找到奖杯，但……至少玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...
if amifingered == True:
: I’m not sure. {i}Did{/i} we have fun, Ami?
lines.zh: : 我不确定。我们{i}玩得开心{/i}吗，Ami？

lines.en: : Losing is never fun. Especially when losing means you get to spend less time with your uncle and that everybody is going to hate you now.
lines.zh: : 输从来都不好玩。尤其是当输意味着你能和叔叔相处的时间变少，而且现在所有人都会讨厌你的时候。

lines.en: : Okay. Then I guess we did not have fun...no.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那我想我们玩得不开心……不开心。

lines.en: else:
: I mean...{i}I{/i} had fun. But I think Ami’s a little down in the dumps since she wasn’t able to earn a point for us.
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}我{/i}玩得挺开心。但我觉得 Ami 有点垂头丧气，因为她没能替我们拿下一分。

lines.en: : Once again, the enemy has won while I have been forced to stand on the sidelines and pretend to be happy for them.
lines.zh: : 又一次，敌人赢了，而我被迫站在场边，假装为她们高兴。

lines.en: : I don’t think anyone’s expecting you to pretend that, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我觉得没人指望你装成那样，Ami。

lines.en: : Good. Because I hate Kirin and Noriko now and I want their floor to collapse.
lines.zh: : 很好。因为我现在恨死 Kirin 和 Noriko 了，我希望她们那层楼塌掉。

lines.en: : You realize we’d probably be killed if that ever happened, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道真要那样我们大概也会没命的，对吧？

lines.en: : Yes. But at least we’ll die {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 知道。但至少我们会死在{i}一起{/i}。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar4
: As exciting as it is to watch you all talk about how much fun you had, I’m going to need to see that trophy.
lines.zh: : 看你们聊自己玩得多开心确实很精彩，但我得看看那座奖杯。

lines.en: : Why? Do you really think I would have gone to the effort of buying a fake one just to win some contest?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你真觉得我会为了赢一场比赛，特地费劲去买个假的？

lines.en: : No...I need to give it back to Miku.
lines.zh: : 不是……我得把它还给 Miku。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} will give it to Miku. Or rather, I will sell it back to her for a small price. Finders keepers.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}会交给 Miku 的。或者说，我会以一个小价钱卖还给她。谁捡到归谁。

lines.en: : Fine. Then I {i}do{/i} need to verify it’s the correct trophy as, even at the height of my disinterest in this year’s war, I still want to win...And what’s left of my life is still ruled by proper protocol.
lines.zh: : 行。那我{i}确实{/i}得确认这是不是正确的奖杯——即便我对今年的大战已经厌烦到了极点，我依然想赢……而我残存的这点人生，依旧受制于正当的程序。

lines.en: : Well, if any of us were having fun, we’re sure not now. Thanks for dragging the mood down, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 好吧，就算刚才有人玩得开心，现在也肯定没了。谢谢你把气氛拖下水，Makoto。

lines.en: : You’re very welcome. Now, please bring that here as I would like to go home.
lines.zh: : 不客气。现在，请把那个拿过来，我想回家了。

lines.en: scene black
: Home? You’re leaving already?
lines.zh: : 回家？你这就要走了？

lines.en: : Don’t we still have a handful of competitions left?
lines.zh: : 我们不是还剩好几场比赛吗？

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar5
: We do. But I’m not needed for any of them and I’ve already fulfilled my purpose in orchestrating and finalizing the scavenger hunt.
lines.zh: : 是的。但剩下的比赛都不需要我，而策划并收尾这场寻宝游戏的职责，我已经完成了。

lines.en: : And seeing as the scavenger hunt is now over, so is my job. Thank you for relieving me of what little responsibility I had this year. It’s been fun. Except for the fact that it hasn’t.
lines.zh: : 既然寻宝结束了，我的工作也就结束了。谢谢你们让我卸下了今年那点少得可怜的责任。挺开心的。除了其实一点都不开心。

lines.en: : You know I was just fucking around when I said you were dragging the mood down, right? It’s not like I actually want you to leave.
lines.zh: : 你知道我说你拖气氛那句只是在开玩笑吧？我又不是真想让你走。

lines.en: : Yeah, stick around for a little while. You can hang out with us.
lines.zh: : 是啊，再待一会儿吧。你可以跟我们一起玩。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar6
: That’s very kind of you, but I’ll have to respectfully decline. My sleep schedule has become rather unpredictable lately and I’m still in the process of getting things back to normal.
lines.zh: : 你们的好意我心领了，但我必须恭敬地谢绝。最近我的作息变得相当不稳定，我还在努力把它调回正轨。

lines.en: : As such, I’ve found it best to just capitalize on every opportunity where I actually {i}want{/i} to sleep.
lines.zh: : 因此我发现，最好的做法就是抓住每一个我真的{i}想{/i}睡觉的机会。

lines.en: : That said, I will likely fail and find myself back here before the night’s end. But, for now?...No thank you.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我很可能会失败，天亮之前又回到这里。但就现在来说？……不了，谢谢。

lines.en: : You try taking sleeping pills or anything? My sister had insomnia for a while and seemed to do a little better on those.
lines.zh: : 你试过吃安眠药之类的吗？我姐姐有段时间失眠，吃了那些似乎稍微好一点。

lines.en: : Do you...actually have any?
lines.zh: : 你……真有吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve got a whole pharmacy in my bag.
lines.zh: : 有啊。我包里装着一整间药房。

lines.en: : I see no bag.
lines.zh: : 我没看到包。

lines.en: : Sorry. I {i}normally{/i} have a whole pharmacy in my bag. But right now, I’ve just got all of my essentials strapped to my upper thigh. Pocket knife, tampons, pills, 4x7 pictures of Sensei...you name it, I’ve got it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我{i}平时{/i}包里是装着一整间药房。但现在，我把所有必需品都绑在大腿上了。折叠刀、卫生棉条、药片、4x7 寸的老师照片……你说得出的，我都有。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar7
: You’re like some kind of prison contraband dealer.
lines.zh: : 你简直像个监狱里的违禁品贩子。

lines.en: : Thanks! I really appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢！我真的很感谢你这么说。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m good on thigh-pills. But thanks for the offer.
lines.zh: : 嗯，大腿上藏的药我就不用了。不过谢谢你的好意。

lines.en: : What else do you have down there?
lines.zh: : 你那下面还藏了什么？

lines.en: : Cell phone...glasses...second pocket knife...a bag of gummy bears...normal stuff.
lines.zh: : 手机……眼镜……第二把折叠刀……一袋小熊软糖……正常的东西。

lines.en: : How do you even walk with all of that on you?
lines.zh: : 带着这一身东西你怎么走路啊？

lines.en: : I normally don’t. I am doing this for the sake of the costume and if something happens to chafe or cut my leg, I’ll just deal with it until I get back to the dorm and can patch myself up.
lines.zh: : 我平时也走不利索。这全是为了这身扮相；要是有什么东西磨到或者割到我的腿，我就先忍着，等回宿舍再自己包扎。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar8
: You gonna be able to wait that long? Cause I’m pretty sure that’s happened already judging by the blood trickling down your leg.
lines.zh: : 你撑得了那么久吗？看你腿上流下来的血，我敢肯定已经割到了。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I brought bandages too.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我还带了创可贴。

lines.en: : Maybe...apply one before you wind up staining the carpet.
lines.zh: : 也许……先贴一个吧，免得你把地毯弄脏了。

lines.en: : Don’t need to! Brought shampoo for carpets as well in case something like this happened!
lines.zh: : 不需要！我还带了地毯清洁剂，就是防着这种事的！

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar9
: How fucking big are your thighs?!
lines.zh: : 你他妈大腿到底有多粗啊？！

lines.en: scene black
scene girlsreturntobar10
: Oh, welcome back. How did your scavenger hunt go?
lines.zh: : 哦，你回来了。你们寻宝得怎么样？

lines.en: : Let’s avoid that topic altogether for now. In fact, better question- how did {i}your{/i} contest go? Please tell me you won.
lines.zh: : 那个话题我们暂时先别提。其实，更好的问题是——{i}你的{/i}比赛怎么样？请告诉我你赢了。

lines.en: : I won.
lines.zh: : 我赢了。

lines.en: if maidwarmaya == True:
scene girlsreturntobar11
: Oh, thank god. I was worried that you were going to be too embarrassed to actually do any maid stuff.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。我还担心你会不好意思，真做不了那些女仆的事。

lines.en: : You underestimate what I am willing to do for food.
lines.zh: : 你低估了我为了食物愿意做到什么地步。

lines.en: : The buffet tickets were really that important to you, huh?
lines.zh: : 自助餐券对你来说真的那么重要吗？

lines.en: : Yes. Not to mention that being a maid is almost {i}excruciatingly{/i} easy and that the return on this investment makes it one of the best decisions I have ever made.
lines.zh: : 是的。更别说当女仆简直轻松得{i}让人难受{/i}，而这份投入的回报，使它成为我做过的最明智的决定之一。

lines.en: else:
: Oh, thank god. I was worried that-
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。我还担心——

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I won by so much that I actually wound up losing.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，我赢得太彻底，结果反倒输了。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar12
: What?! How is that even possible?! That makes no sense!
lines.zh: : 什么？！这怎么可能？！完全说不通啊！

lines.en: : It makes perfect sense when you remember who the judge of this competition is and how passionately he enjoys making my life hell.
lines.zh: : 只要你记得这场比赛的评委是谁，以及他是多么热衷于把我的生活变成地狱，这就完全说得通了。

lines.en: : Are you saying Sensei only voted against you because...he wanted to piss you off?
lines.zh: : 你是说老师投你反对票，只是因为……他想气你？

lines.en: : That is precisely what I am saying. And I’d likely be quite torn up about it if being a maid wasn’t the actual easiest thing I have ever had to do.
lines.zh: : 我正是这个意思。要不是当女仆是我干过最轻松的事，我大概会为此相当难受。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar13
: Wait...{i}easy?!{/i} What do you mean {i}easy?!{/i} I work my butt off at that place!
lines.zh: : 等等……{i}轻松？！{/i}你说{i}轻松{/i}是什么意思？！我在那地方可是拼死拼活的！

lines.en: : Doing what? The same exact things you do at home but {i}without{/i} the actual “maid-like” parts? Because I’d call house-Ami more of a maid than maid-Ami.
lines.zh: : 拼什么？不就是你在家做的那些一模一样的事，只是{i}去掉了{/i}真正「像女仆」的部分吗？要我说，家里的 Ami 可比女仆 Ami 更像女仆。

lines.en: : So long as you know how to talk and appeal to people, being a maid in a cafe is as simple as snapping your fingers and learning to draw a heart on a plate of eggs.
lines.zh: : 只要你会说话、会讨人喜欢，在咖啡厅当女仆简单得就像打个响指，再学会在一盘鸡蛋上画个爱心。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar14
: Were you...actually good, though? Like...did you really do...maid-like stuff in front of Sensei?
lines.zh: : 不过你……真的表现很好吗？就是……你真的在老师面前做了那些……女仆才会做的事？

lines.en: : Why? Are you jealous?
lines.zh: : 怎么？你吃醋了？

lines.en: : Yes, but I don’t know if I’m jealous of you for being the one to serve him or jealous of {i}him{/i} for being the one you served.
lines.zh: : 是的，但我不知道我是嫉妒你是伺候他的那个人，还是嫉妒{i}他{/i}是被你伺候的那个人。

lines.en: : I would like service from maid Maya as well, please.
lines.zh: : 我也想享受一次女仆 Maya 的服务，拜托了。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar15
: It’s {i}Moe Moe Maya,{/i} thank you very much.
lines.zh: : 是{i}萌萌 Maya{/i}，非常感谢。

lines.en: : Wow...you actually {i}did{/i} do it, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇……你{i}真的{/i}做了啊？

lines.en: : Again, the lengths I am willing to go to for food are quite dramatic.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我为了食物能做到的程度，是相当夸张的。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: But that’s enough about me. Please tell me how-
lines.zh: : 不过我说了够多了。请跟我说说——

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar16
: I told you I don’t want to talk about that.
lines.zh: : 我说了我不想谈这个。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar17
: I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Me and Ayane walked around the old district looking for a trophy that we never found.
lines.zh: : 我和 Ayane 在旧城区转了一圈，找一座我们根本没找到的奖杯。

lines.en: : Nothing else happened and we’re done talking about it now.
lines.zh: : 别的什么都没发生，这个话题到此为止。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar18
: Ayane, do {i}you{/i} have anything you’d like to add? Or should I just assume that this is one more thing the two of you don’t want me to know for some reason?
lines.zh: : Ayane，{i}你{/i}有什么想补充的吗？还是说我干脆就这么认为：这又是一件你们俩出于某种原因不想让我知道的事？

lines.en: : You say that...as if you’ve never kept anything from us...
lines.zh: : 你这话说的……好像你从来没瞒过我们什么似的……

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar19
: Very well, then. Forget I asked in the first place. It’s not as if I care about anything that goes on on that side of town anyway.
lines.zh: : 那么好吧。就当我从没问过。反正我对那一带发生的任何事也没什么兴趣。

lines.en: : Why is it you...avoid going over there in the first place, Maya? It’s not like-
lines.zh: : 可你到底为什么……一开始就躲着不去那边呢，Maya？又不是——

lines.en: : Sorry, but if you two aren’t going to answer questions, I have no reason to answer any directed toward me.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，既然你们两个不打算回答问题，我也没理由回答指向我的问题。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll please excuse me, I’m going to go stand off to the side of the room and remember the good old days when my friends did not intentionally exclude me from things.
lines.zh: : 那么，失陪了。我要去房间边上站着，回忆一下过去那些好日子——那时我的朋友们还不会故意把我排除在外。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar20
: Oh...okay. See you later, then.
lines.zh: : 哦……好吧。那回头见。

lines.en: : Hah...
: I can’t tell if we actually pissed her off or if she’s just being tsundere again.
lines.zh: : 我分不清我们到底是真把她惹毛了，还是她又在傲娇。

lines.en: : Probably both. But at least it’s her being left out this time instead of me.
lines.zh: : 大概两者都有。不过至少这次被排除在外的是她，不是我。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar21
: Huh? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 啊？你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that you two have been talking to each other alone and coming to school alone and doing a bunch of other stuff {i}alone{/i} lately and it makes me feel bad!
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，最近你们俩老是自己跟自己说话、自己一个人上学，还有一堆别的事也是{i}自己一个人{/i}做，这让我很难受！

lines.en: : We’re supposed to be the Sensei Love Squad! Not the “Secretly Exclude One Person From Everything Important” Squad!
lines.zh: : 我们应该是「老师后援团」！不是「偷偷把所有重要的事都排除掉一个人团」！

lines.en: : I’d hope so. That’s a really long name for a squad.
lines.zh: : 我也希望是。这团名也太长了吧。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar22
: Ugh. I’m just tired, I think. Today was emotionally draining and I didn’t expect you to find out about that thing that you found out about until later.
lines.zh: : 唉。我想我只是累了。今天情绪消耗太大，而且我没料到你会这么快就知道那件事。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you...expected me to find out at all.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你……本来就打算让我知道。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar23
: You were always going to find out. I just figured I would have {i}known{/i} when you found out since I didn’t think Sensei would just openly tell you about it.
lines.zh: : 你迟早都会知道的。我只是以为你会先告诉我你是什么时候{i}知道{/i}的，因为我没想到老师会就这么直接告诉你。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar24
: But the fact that he did means that he just loves me even more than I thought he did! I mean...why else would he openly profess all the things we do together to someone {i}else{/i} who loves him?
lines.zh: : 但他真的这么做了，这说明他比我想象的还要爱我！我是说……不然他为什么要向{i}另一个{/i}爱他的人坦白我们之间做的那些事？

lines.en: : Uhh...Ami?
lines.zh: : 呃……Ami？

lines.en: : What? Are you going to tell me {i}you’re{/i} sleeping with him too? Because we both know that would never happen if he loves {i}me{/i} as much as he obviously does.
lines.zh: : 怎么？你该不会要告诉我{i}你{/i}也跟他上床了吧？因为我们都清楚，既然他显然这么爱{i}我{/i}，那种事就绝不可能发生。

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene girlsreturntobar25
: You know what? I’m thirsty.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？我渴了。

lines.en: : Let’s go see if Sara can make us anything non-alcoholic.
lines.zh: : 我们去看看 Sara 能不能给我们调点无酒精的。

lines.en: : Okay, Ayane. Whatever you want!
lines.zh: : 好的，Ayane。你想怎样都行！

lines.en: scene black
else:
scene black
: But that's enough about me. Tell me how things went for you guys.
lines.zh: : 不过我说了够多了。跟我说说你们那边怎么样吧。

lines.en: : Well, it all started when-
lines.zh: : 嗯，事情是这样的——

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar26
: Is something the matter, Emerald Guardian? It is not like you to call for a guild meeting with only two members.
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗，翡翠守护者？你可不像是会只召集两名成员开公会会议的人。

lines.en: : Can we drop the act for a second, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能先别演了，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : Act?
: I’ve gotta be mean to you for a minute and it’s gonna be mighty hard doing that with you calling me by my codename.
lines.zh: : 我得对你凶一会儿，可你一直叫我代号，这让我很难凶得起来。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar27
: I’m confused. Have I done something to anger you? Because I don’t believe I have acted out of the ordinary in any-
lines.zh: : 我有些困惑。是我做了什么惹你生气的事吗？因为我不觉得自己有哪一点表现得反常——

lines.en: : The bloody hell was that last night?
lines.zh: : 昨晚那到底是他妈什么情况？

lines.en: : I believe the technical term is “Standing up comedy.” It is short for “Stand-up comedy,” which is a style of telling jokes that-
lines.zh: : 我想专业术语应该叫「站着的喜剧」。它是「站立喜剧」的简称，是一种讲笑话的形式——

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar28
: I obviously mean about the “jokes” you told. Those weren’t jokes {i}at all.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我显然是在说你讲的那些「笑话」。那些{i}根本不是笑话{/i}。

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how hard I worked to patch things up with the Herald of...with {i}Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你知道我费了多大劲才和……{i}和老师{/i}把关系修补好吗？

lines.en: : Were you trying to ruin that? Do you not want me near him for some reason you have not yet disclosed to me?
lines.zh: : 你是想把它毁掉吗？你是有什么还没告诉我的理由，不想让我靠近他吗？

lines.en: : You are supposed to be my best friend. I’m supposed to be able to trust you. You should have known how uncomfortable that would have made me and-
lines.zh: : 你本该是我最好的朋友。我本该能够信任你。你早就该知道那会让我有多不舒服，而且——

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar29
: And...
lines.zh: : 而且……

lines.en: : Are you referring to the jokes about the semen?
lines.zh: : 你是指那些关于精液的笑话吗？

lines.en: : Molly?
lines.zh: : Molly？

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar30
: Huh? Yeah. Those are the ones.
lines.zh: : 啊？对。就是那些。

lines.en: : I understand. But I did not think bringing those things up in such a setting would lead to such a reaction from you.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。但我没想到在那种场合提起那些事，会让你有如此的反应。

lines.en: : There are many comedians who draw upon real life experiences to-
lines.zh: : 有很多喜剧演员都会取材于真实经历来——

lines.en: : Have you not learned compassion in all of our time together?
lines.zh: : 我们相处了这么久，你难道还没学会体谅吗？

lines.en: : Have you not learned the things that make me worried or uneasy? Or scared or nervous? Or any of that? Any of the things I have finally begun to move {i}past{/i} feeling on a daily basis?
lines.zh: : 你难道还没弄清什么会让我担心、不安？什么会让我害怕、紧张？或者任何类似的？任何那些我好不容易才开始{i}不再{/i}每天感受的东西？

lines.en: : Why would you wake those up? And for {i}laughs{/i} no less...
lines.zh: : 你为什么要把它们重新唤醒？而且还是为了{i}逗笑{/i}……

lines.en: : Am I a joke to you?
lines.zh: : 对你来说我是个笑话吗？

lines.en: : Or are you just {i}pretending{/i} to be oblivious right now?
lines.zh: : 还是说你现在只是{i}装{/i}糊涂？

lines.en: : Tsuneyo...talk to me.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo……说话啊。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar31
: I am not good at that.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长这个。

lines.en: : What, and I am?
lines.zh: : 什么，我就擅长吗？

lines.en: : There are too many skill trees in life to spec into all of ‘em...and there are gonna be times when we’ve gotta dig into our spellbook and put stuff we forgot we even had onto the hotbar.
lines.zh: : 人生里的技能树太多了，不可能全都点满……总有些时候，我们得翻翻自己的法术书，把那些我们早忘了自己还有的东西拖到快捷栏上。

lines.en: : What I’m trying to say is...just because we’re not good at certain things doesn’t mean we can avoid them forever if the mechanics of a fight call for them.
lines.zh: : 我想说的是……就算我们不擅长某些事，也不代表只要战斗机制需要它们，我们就能永远躲着不做。

lines.en: : It’s either that or we just give up. And if there is anything I have learned from my time in Elden Ring, it is that Malenia is not going to just kill herself.
lines.zh: : 要么这样，要么我们就干脆放弃。如果说我在 Elden Ring 里学到了什么，那就是玛莲妮亚是不会自己死掉的。

lines.en: : Peer into that inventory and see what you’ve got, Tsuneyo. Because there’ll always be something that’ll help...and whatever that something is is a little different for everybody.
lines.zh: : 翻翻你的物品栏，看看你都有什么，Tsuneyo。因为总会有某样东西能派上用场……而那样东西对每个人来说都不太一样。

lines.en: : I do not understand any of what you just said, but I will do my best to explain my actions.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说的我一句都没听懂，但我会尽力解释自己的行为。

lines.en: : One year ago, my inattentiveness and disregard for your safety led to you being harmed.
lines.zh: : 一年前，我的疏忽大意、对你的安危毫不在意，导致你受到了伤害。

lines.en: : And while you have chosen to believe that you were not harmed at all, it does not change what I saw and my thoughts on what may have happened that night.
lines.zh: : 尽管你选择相信自己根本没有受到伤害，这依然改变不了我亲眼所见，以及我对那晚可能发生过什么的判断。

lines.en: : If I had only been there sooner, I could have prevented-
lines.zh: : 要是我能早点到场，我本可以阻止——

lines.en: : It’s not your job to take care of me, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 照顾我不是你的责任，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar32
: But it is when you can not take care of yourself.
lines.zh: : 但在你照顾不了自己的时候，就是。

lines.en: : Were you in the right state of mind to make decisions that night? Or were there multiple “debuffs” and “status effects” that disallowed you from acting of your own volition?
lines.zh: : 那晚你的精神状态适合做决定吗？还是说身上带着一堆「减益」和「状态效果」，让你无法按自己的意志行动？

lines.en: : You are the first person other than my father that I have ever connected with. And it is my duty to protect you.
lines.zh: : 除了我父亲之外，你是第一个真正与我产生羁绊的人。而保护你是我的职责。

lines.en: : How are you going to protect me from something that already happened?
lines.zh: : 你要怎么保护我不受一件已经发生的事的伤害？

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar33
: By not letting it happen again.
lines.zh: : 不让它再次发生。

lines.en: : That’s not what you did.
lines.zh: : 你做的可不是这个。

lines.en: : All you did was reawaken the uncertainties of that night in not just me, but in Sensei as well.
lines.zh: : 你做的只是重新唤醒了那晚的不确定性——不只在我心里，也在老师心里。

lines.en: : I’m sure this will sound hard to believe, but I think that...he was just as much of a victim in that as I was.
lines.zh: : 我知道这听起来很难相信，但我觉得……在那件事里，他和我一样都是受害者。

lines.en: : No one paid closer attention to him in the coming days than I did. Not even Ami. And the way he acted was not of a man who did something malicious, but of a man who had something malicious done to {i}him.{/i}
lines.zh: : 在随后的日子里，没有人比我更密切地关注他。连 Ami 都比不上。而{i}他{/i}的举止，不像一个做了恶事的人，倒像一个被恶事施加的人。

lines.en: : What if I was the one who forced his hand? And what if all of those “jokes” you told reminded him of that?
lines.zh: : 万一逼他动手的人是我呢？万一你讲的那些「笑话」让他想起了这些呢？

lines.en: : There’s far too much unknown about that night to justify telling stories about it. But even if all {i}was{/i} known, it would not be your story to tell.
lines.zh: : 那晚的未知太多，根本不足以拿来编故事讲。可即便一切{i}真相大白{/i}，那也不是你该讲的故事。

lines.en: : You really disappointed me, Tsuneyo...
lines.zh: : 你真的让我失望，Tsuneyo……

lines.en: : I didn’t think that would ever happen with you.
lines.zh: : 我从没想过你会让我失望。

lines.en: scene girlsreturntobar34
: I apologize for my actions...but I can not rid my mind of the horrible state I saw you in that night.
lines.zh: : 我为自己的行为道歉……可我无法把那晚看到你的可怕模样从脑海里抹去。

lines.en: : And saying what I did seemed like the only way to make it so I wasn’t the only one who knew anymore.
lines.zh: : 而把那些话说出来，似乎是唯一能让我不再是唯一知情者的办法。

lines.en: : The idea of anyone harming you is too much for me to bear. And I believe that anyone who does so should have to pay a price.
lines.zh: : 光是想到有人伤害你，我就承受不住。而且我相信，任何这样做的人都必须付出代价。

lines.en: : But...as it appears my words were truly just taken as mere “jokes,” you don’t have anything to worry about...
lines.zh: : 不过……既然我的话看来真的只被当成了「笑话」，那你也没什么好担心的了……

lines.en: : I do, though. I have to worry about you doing that again.
lines.zh: : 不，我有。我得担心你下次还会这么做。

lines.en: : Molly...
lines.zh: : Molly……

lines.en: : Tell me you {i}won’t.{/i}
lines.zh: : 答应我{i}你不会{/i}。

lines.en: : You can protect me all you want from things that haven’t happened yet, but don’t try rewriting the past and turning matters I have already settled into ones much greater than they wound up being.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么保护我免受那些还没发生的事都可以，但别试图改写过去，把我已经放下的事重新放大成比实际严重得多的样子。

lines.en: : I don’t trust him with you anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不再放心把你交给他了。

lines.en: : Do you trust {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你信任{i}我{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Then trust the {i}me{/i} who trusts {i}him.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那就信任那个信任{i}他{/i}的{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : That quote works better in its original context and phrasing but, what I’m trying to say is just...let me decide things like this for myself.
lines.zh: : 那句话在原来的语境和措辞里更有味道，不过我想说的是……这种事让我自己来决定。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t care so much about my relationship with Sensei if he was not an important person to me.
lines.zh: : 如果老师对我来说不是重要的人，我也不会这么在意和他的关系。

lines.en: : And, as another person who is very important to me, you have to understand that.
lines.zh: : 而作为另一个对我来说非常重要的人，你必须要明白这一点。

lines.en: scene black
: I will do my best.
lines.zh: : 我会尽力的。

lines.en: : Please continue to be kind to me in the future.
lines.zh: : 今后也请继续对我温柔一些。

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: : And please let {i}me{/i} continue to dress you up in different outfits.
lines.zh: : 还有，请让{i}我{/i}继续给你换各种不同的装扮。

lines.en: : Okay. But please stop groping me when I do so.
lines.zh: : 可以。但请在给我换装的时候不要再乱摸了。

lines.en: : Please don’t tell me how to live my life.
lines.zh: : 请不要对我的人生指手画脚。
